label: Dropbox Backup Folder
description: Sends Backup Set and archive CSV files to a Dropbox folder. Make the connection in Setup first (an Auth Provider for Dropbox, then an External Credential and a Named Credential named BarnConn_dropbox with the URL https://content.dropboxapi.com and principal OAuth), as the admin guide's Backup Destination section describes. Dropbox takes the file's path in the Dropbox-API-Arg header, where {file} is filled in for each file.
